title.zh: 微软要把Windows变成Agent工作台：AI能直接操作电脑，还能少花Token
title.en: 微软要把Windows变成Agent工作台：AI能直接操作电脑，还能少花Token

current_state.zh: Microsoft unveiled a Windows 'Hybrid Intelligence' plan that lets Copilot agents directly operate a PC, running a compressed 137B-parameter MAI Code 1.1 Flash model locally on RTX Spark hardware alongside cloud models routed via HydraFusion, with an MXC sandbox to constrain file and network access.
